title: Preview application email suppression passes; upstream delivery remains unverified
summary: 17 synthetic email tests and local signup suppression passed. SMTP/Hook and hosted binding remain blocking gates. No real mail or deployment.

changes.detail: Added synthetic transport and actual route-handler tests and precise local binding/upstream SMTP inspection instructions.
Test harness initially read main-workspace files; corrected it to resolve candidate source relative to the test module. No application change was needed for that harness failure.

validation.name: Application mail isolation
validation.detail: 17/17 synthetic tests; actual local signup returns 403 SEO_PREVIEW_EMAIL_SUPPRESSED before side effects. No real recipients or service calls.

validation.name: Production compatibility
validation.detail: 120 recovery tests and production mail/transport branch tests passed.

validation.name: Upstream email isolation
validation.detail: Email provider and signups disabled; zero Edge Functions. Managed SMTP and Send Email Hook configuration inaccessible through connected tools; no browser session. Direct public Auth calls remain outside app guards.

validation.name: Hosted binding equality
validation.detail: Preview-only key scope confirmed. New binding absent at audit; user had not saved it. Masked helper parity passed using synthetic input and mocked clipboard.
